comparison.objective: Saw through a log at a chalk mark using a two-person crosscut saw.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated alternating pulling while preventing thin-blade compression and kinking.
comparison.success_condition: Complete the cut with one hand on each handle, avoid pushing/kinking, then release the saw.
comparison.reason: Tests sustained reciprocal cutting and load coordination, not precision impact through a coaxial break-off mandrel or fragment recovery.
